title: Building D: load step on one path, on the farm, without its BESS
summary: Path D-A is out for maintenance and path D-B runs on its generator farm (35 kV utility lost). The BESS D-B breaker was left open after an inspection. A synchronised training job will step the hall by +12 MW in 90 s. The farm accepts load at a limited rate (model); without the BESS the bus cannot follow the step and the hall goes dark. Restore the BESS before the step, then watch it carry the step. Simulated plant (ADR-023), model values. Switching the procedure does not call for counts as a violation.

steps.text: Acknowledge the Building D path B alarms in the alarm banner
Close the BESS D-B breaker before the load step
Watch the BESS carry the step until the job settles
